scripts.dev: npm run build:contracts && concurrently -n "api,web" -c "blue,green" "npm run dev -w @qualityops/api" "npm run dev -w @qualityops/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:contracts && npm run typecheck -w @qualityops/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @qualityops/api && npm run typecheck -w @qualityops/web
scripts.test: npm run build:contracts && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.build: npm run build:contracts && npm run build -w @qualityops/api && npm run build -w @qualityops/web
